mapping: Existing SXR reference samplePoint mapping, with VR700 stock parameters: rotate panel UV once in OpenVR adapter; x=2u-1,y=2v-1; r2=x*x+(1920/1832*y)^2; RGB UV=0.5+0.5*(x/sx,y/sy)*P(r2)*rgb_scale. Preserve outside-image UV. Display FOV is used, not *_mesh FOV.
basis: VR700 stock config has zero lens offsets, unit lens scale, inverse=false and even polynomial. The panel timing matches the independent VR700 kernel driver. This parameterization does not establish equivalence to the shipped Android warp implementation.
tracking_calibration: Per-device camera/IMU calibration remains a private producer input; no MIX calibration is included.
